steps: Choose 'Fine-grained personal access token' (the page opens on it)
Name it after the project and pick an expiration
Choose the one repository (or only the repositories) it needs, then the smallest permissions that work
Copy the token now - it is shown exactly once

limited.meaning: the token is valid but this kind of token may not read your user profile; that is fine

least_privilege.summary: Fine-grained token, one repository, only the permissions you need, with an expiry. Avoid classic tokens with the broad 'repo' scope.
